Battery lumped-parameter thermal model (ODE): m·c_p·dT/dt = I²·R(T) − I·T·dU/dT − h·A·(T − T_cool) R(T) = R_ref·exp(E_a/R_gas·(1/T − 1/T_ref)) (Arrhenius) I = C_rate × rated capacity; dU/dT = −3e−4 V/K (Bernardi reversible heat, discharge convention)

1-D Stefan problem (enthalpy-method FDM): ρ·∂H/∂t = k·∂²T/∂x² H(T) = c_{p,s}·T, T < T_melt = c_{p,s}·T_melt + L_f·f_s, T = T_melt (latent heat) BC: −k·∂T/∂x|_0 = h_eff·(T − T_mold), h_eff = (1/h_c + ell_mold/k_mold)^−1

Darcy seepage (Laplace equation, heterogeneous): ∇·(K(x,z)·∇H) = 0, (x,z) ∈ Ω K = K_curtain in the grout-curtain column, K_base elsewhere BC: H = H1 upstream, H = H2 downstream, top and bottom impermeable except a simplified drain node with H_d = H2 + (1-drain_eff)·(H1-H2)/2 when H_d is below the no-drain natural head at the drain node, bedrock bottom impermeable (∂H/∂n = 0). Uplift: u(x) = γ_w · H(x, z = 0)
1-D fin equation: d²θ/dx² − m²θ = 0, θ = T − T_∞ m² = h·P/(k·A), P = 2(W+t), A = W·t Adiabatic tip: θ(x) = θ_b·cosh(m(H−x))/cosh(mH) η_fin = tanh(mH)/(mH)

1-D adiabatic fixed-bed ODE system (residence time as independent var): dθ/dτ = −Da · θ · exp(γ(1 − 1/T̃)) dT̃/dτ = β · Da · θ · exp(γ(1 − 1/T̃)) where θ = C_A/C_A0, T̃ = T/T_in, Da = k₀·exp(−Ea/R/T_in) [Damköhler number] β = (−ΔH_r)·C_A0/(ρ·C_p·T_in) [adiabatic temp-rise number] γ = Ea·1000/(R·T_in) [Arrhenius dimensionless activation energy] For the irreversible exothermic adiabatic model, dT̃/dτ ≥ 0 and T_max = T_outlet.

1-D ADE (advection–dispersion–reaction): R·∂C/∂t = D·∂²C/∂x² − v·∂C/∂x − λ·C Ogata–Banks-style erfc solution with adsorption R and separable decay attenuation D = α_L·v + D_m·τ, R = 1 + ρ_b·K_d/(1000·n) for K_d in L/kg
∇·(k(x,y)·∇T) = 0 [2-D steady state] k(x,y) = k_A (x < x_split), k_B (x ≥ x_split) BC: T(x,0) = T_hot, T(x,1) = T_cold, left/right adiabatic

Inglis solution (elliptical hole, infinite plate): Kt_x = 1 + 2·(a/b) (sigma_x perpendicular to major axis) Kt_y = 1 + 2·(b/a) = 1 + 2/(a/b) (sigma_y perpendicular to minor axis) Finite-width correction (Pilkey 2008, Chart 4.1, Heywood polynomial): K_Heywood(a/W) = 1 + 0.5·clip(2a/W,0,0.75)³ + 0.3·clip(2a/W,0,0.75)⁵ Biaxial superposition at hole-edge end points: Point A (major-axis end): σ_A = σ_x · Kt_x · K_Heywood − σ_y Point B (minor-axis end): σ_B = σ_y · Kt_y · K_Heywood − σ_x Oblique-load shear term: |τ_xy| · 2(1+a/b) · K_Heywood σ_max = max(|σ_A|, |σ_B|) + shear term (Circular-hole limit Kt_x = Kt_y = 3 recovers Kirsch's 3σ_x − σ_y.)

Thin-walled cylindrical pressure-vessel membrane-stress surrogate: Hoop stress: σ_θ = P·R / t Axial stress: σ_a = P·R / (2t) Von Mises: σ_VM = P·R/t · √3/2 Safety factor: FS = σ_y / σ_VM Mass per unit length: m/L = ρ·π·((R+t)²−R²) ≈ 2πRt·ρ [ρ = 7850 kg/m³] Scope: strength-only thin-wall surrogate, not a full ASME BPVC, thick-wall, local-stress, fatigue/fracture, or buckling design check

LOX/LH2 thermochemical surrogate + ideal nozzle equations: Adiabatic chamber: empirical MR/T0/P_c correlations → T_c, γ_eff, M_eff Isentropic nozzle: c*=√(γRT_c/M)/(γ·(2/(γ+1))^((γ+1)/(2γ−2))) Isp = c*·Cf/g0; Cf determined by area ratio and pressure ratio Scope: trend/identity surrogate, not NASA CEA Gibbs-minimisation thermochemistry, finite-rate chemistry, equilibrium/frozen expansion, or engine-cycle design

BEMT (coupled blade-element / momentum): Hover momentum: dCT = 4F·lambda_i^2·r_bar·dr_bar Blade element: dCT = 0.5·sigma·CL·r_bar^2·dr_bar Station solve: lambda_i - sqrt(max(sigma·CL(lambda_i)·r_bar,0)/(8F(lambda_i))) = 0 CP = max(CP_blade_ind, kappa·CT^(3/2)/√2) + CP_profile, kappa=1.10 FM = CT^(3/2) / (√2·CP)

Terzaghi 1-D consolidation PDE: du_e/dt = c_v * d^2 u_e / dz^2 c_v = k / (m_v * gamma_w) BC: u_e(0,t) = 0 (drained top), du_e/dz(H,t) = 0 (impermeable base) IC: u_e(z,0) = delta_sigma U(t) = 1 - sum_{m=0}^inf (2/M^2) exp(-M^2 T_v) S(t) = U(t) * m_v * delta_sigma * H_dr

PV specific annual yield model (IEC 61724): G_eff = GHI · f_tilt(β) · f_azimuth(γ_dev) T_cell_avg ≈ 25 + [20 − 60·(η_STC − 0.20)]·G_eff/1400 T_corr = 1 + (β_T/100)·(T_cell − 25) [β_T in %/°C] E_annual [kWh/kWp] = G_eff · T_corr · PR / G_STC, G_STC = 1 kW/m²

Two-ramp inviscid external-compression intake surrogate: tan(δ)=2cotβ·(Ma²sin²β−1)/(Ma²(γ+cos2β)+2) Equivalent denominator: (γ+1)Ma²−2(Ma²sin²β−1) Weak attached oblique shocks + terminal normal shock; cumulative total-pressure ratio Strong-shock branch/back-pressure selection is outside the benchmark scope Calorically perfect constant-gamma shock equations; gamma sweep is a gas-property stressor Detached-shock/off-design fallback is a surrogate penalty, not CFD or inlet-unstart modelling

Prandtl Lifting-Line Theory (PLLT): Γ(θ)=2b·V∞·ΣAₙ·sin(nθ), station equation: ΣAₙ[sin(nθ)+n·μ·sin(nθ)/sin(θ)]=μ·α_eff(θ), μ=c·a0/(4b) CL=π·AR·A₁, CDi=π·AR·ΣnAₙ²=CL²/(π·AR)·(1+δ), e=CL²/(π·AR·CDi) Prandtl–Glauert correction: a0→a0/√(1−Ma²), CL→CL_incomp/√(1−Ma²)
